title: Suffixes
descriptionFa: پسوندهایی مثل er، ful، less، ness و y که از یه کلمه، کلمه‌ی جدید می‌سازن.

words.example: He's a hard worker. He works twelve hours a day.
words.tipFa: -er / -or = آدمی که کاری می‌کنه: swimmer, footballer, instructor.

words.example: She's a very good swimmer. She was in the national team.
My driving instructor is very patient.
Do you know a good builder who can work on our house?
Marco Polo was a famous traveller.
Can we use a calculator in the maths test?
words.tipFa: -er / -or برای دستگاه هم هست: cooker, opener, hairdryer.

words.example: Can I use your bottle opener, please?
Thanks for the information. It was very useful.
words.tipFa: -ful = پر از: useful, helpful, hopeful. -less = بدون: useless, painless.

words.example: This old phone is useless. It doesn't work.
The waiter was very helpful and explained everything on the menu.
Check your work. Don't make careless mistakes.
I can't finish this book. It's endless!
Don't worry. The injection is painless.
They are happily married with two children.
words.tipFa: y آخر به i تبدیل می‌شه: happy → happily, easy → easily.
-ness از صفت اسم می‌سازه: sad → sadness, kind → kindness.

words.example: They said goodbye with great sadness.
Thank you very much for all your kindness.
That beach is very popular because it's long and sandy.
words.tipFa: -y از اسم صفت می‌سازه: sand → sandy, sun → sunny, rain → rainy.
